name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 40 - Am 61
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 40a. Calls upon Members and former Members who retain entitlements under the Additional (Voluntary) Pension Scheme to voluntarily and irrevocably waive such rights and entitlements, in order to facilitate the closure of the Additional Pension Fund and relieve Parliament budget of any future liabilities arising from the Scheme;
